channel.title: The Clanton Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Clanton Advertiser (clantonadvertiser.com)

item.title: If You Build It — Lots of firsts at Rebels' new softball park
item.description: After 38 years at a city park, Thorsby softball opened its own on-campus field, celebrating the debut with a 13-1 win over Billingsley and a standout day from pitcher Brooklyn Reeser.

item.title: Perfecto — Hallman tosses perfect game in season opener for CMS
item.description: Clanton Middle School’s Lane Hallman tosses a five-inning perfect game with 13 strikeouts in the season opener, leading CMS to a 4-0 win and doubleheader sweep of Marbury.

item.title: A New Age — CCS details projects at Verbena’s annex, high school campuses
item.description: Chilton County Schools will add a full-service kitchen, new classrooms and a new gym-anchored athletic complex to Verbena campuses, with work expected to finish by year’s end.

item.title: CCHS girls grab two wins, climb to .500 in week’s soccer action
item.description: CCHS girls soccer triples last year’s win total with a 2-0 week to reach .500, while the boys learn lessons but stay 5-1-1 as a busy stretch of matches looms.

item.title: UAB St. Vincent’s Chilton installs new system for scanning entire organs
item.description: UAB St. Vincent’s Chilton installs a new CT system that scans entire organs in 0.23 seconds, enabling faster, low-dose imaging for cardiac, brain, oncology, bone and pediatric care.

item.title: Open Season — Thorsby opens with a win in a new ballpark; Billingsley walks off MA
item.description: Thorsby christens its new on-campus ballpark with a win, Billingsley walks off Montgomery Academy, and Maplesville posts three wins in Chilton County softball action from Feb. 18-25.

item.title: Opening Day — The 2026 baseball season opens in Chilton County
item.description: Walk-off hits and late-inning drama marked opening week as seven Chilton County area high school teams kicked off the 2026 baseball season.

item.title: Panthers prowl in newly renovated baseball stadium
item.description: Jemison High School unveils renovated baseball stadium with new batting cage, brick dugouts and upgraded fan amenities as part of countywide facility projects.

item.title: Relay for Life Pageant ready to inspire, raise awareness for twelfth year
item.description: Chilton County’s 12th annual Miss Relay for Life Pageant is set for April 25 at CCHS, with contestants ages 4-18 raising funds for the American Cancer Society.

item.title: Let it grow, let it grow — Clanton recognized as a Tree City USA city
item.description: Clanton earns 2025 Tree City USA status as residents line up in the cold for the annual free giveaway of 1,200 native trees and celebrate 31 years of Arbor Day efforts.
